title: silly lastlife remake
description: A faithful remake of the series "Last Life" by Grian and crew in datapack form!
body:
commands for admins:

- /function life:setup (sets-up everything)
- /function life:reset (starts season and rolls lives)
- /function life:boogeyman/boogeyman5 (rolls boogeyman in 5 minutes)
- /function life:boogeyman/boogeyfail (fails the boogeymen selected, used for ending the session)
- /scoreboard players set/add/remove <player> Lives <number> (sets the lives of a player)
- /scoreboard players set/add <player> Kills <number> (adds or sets a kill for a player, used if the boogeyman didnt get cured properly)
- /function life:numboogey (shows the number of boogeymen left in chat for everyone)

commands for players:
- /trigger lives (see how many lives you have left)
- /trigger GiveLife (give a life to the nearest person)


- P.S, if this gets popular enough i might do another season twist!!
